extracted.intended_audience: inventors, companies, patent applicants, patent attorneys and national IP Offices seeking to use the PCT system
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for seeking patent protection abroad using the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT): how to file and manage an international (PCT) application, meet time limits and fees, enter national phases, and use WIPO tools and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: File a PCT application
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about how to file a PCT application, including the required elements, basic requirements, practical details and applicable fees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers the procedural steps to submit a single international patent application under the PCT; includes information on required elements and applicable fees (see PCT Applicant's Guide and PCT Forms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Required elements and basic requirements of a PCT application
rubrics_metrics.description: The PCT Applicant's Guide explains the required elements and basic requirements for an international application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must ensure their application meets the PCT's formal and substantive requirements (as detailed in the Applicant's Guide and PCT legal texts) before filing; the page points users to the Applicant's Guide for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage your PCT application (procedures and deadlines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand how to manage your PCT application throughout the international phase, including important procedures and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Managing an international phase application requires tracking and complying with PCT procedures and strict time limits; use the PCT Time Limit Calculator and follow guidance in the Applicant's Guide and Official Notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enter the national phase
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out when and how to proceed with your PCT application in the national phase
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To obtain protection in designated Contracting States, applicants must timely enter the national/regional phases according to each jurisdiction's requirements and deadlines—guidance and timing found in the Applicant's Guide, PCT legal texts and national authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ePCT — online filing and management
rubrics_metrics.description: Use ePCT to file and manage your international applications as an applicant, or process international applications as a patent Office
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ePCT is WIPO's online service for filing and managing PCT applications; applicants and Offices should use ePCT for electronic filing, document management and interactions during the international phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult PCT legal texts and guidance materials
rubrics_metrics.description: PCT legal resources: PCT legal texts, reservations and incompatibilities, Directives of the PCT Assembly, ISA/IPEA Agreements, PCT Forms
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should consult the primary legal instruments and agreements governing PCT procedure (and any reservations/incompatibilities) to ensure compliance; the page links to legal texts and related instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT Forms and Official Notices (PCT Gazette)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the correct PCT Forms and monitor Official Notices (PCT Gazette)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing and procedural actions require the correct, current PCT forms; stay informed of changes via Official Notices and the PCT Gazette which publish updates and fee tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT Fees — check applicable fees
rubrics_metrics.description: PCT Fees are a necessary consideration when filing and prosecuting international applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must calculate and pay applicable fees (international filing, search, examination, transmittal, etc.) as part of filing and national phase entry; fee schedules are available on the PCT Fees page.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT Time Limit Calculator and awareness of deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Time limits are a key element of PCT procedures; use the PCT Time Limit Calculator
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadlines under the PCT are jurisdictionally and procedurally important—applicants should compute deadlines precisely (priority, international phase acts, national phase entry) using WIPO tools and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT education and training resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Register for upcoming PCT training events or explore past training recordings and resources (Learn the PCT video series, Distance Learning Course, webinars, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO offers training (video lectures, webinars, distance learning) to help applicants and Offices understand filing, management and national phase requirements; leveraging these resources is recommended for compliance and best practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep up-to-date via newsletters and Applicant's Guide updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscribe to PCT Newsletter and PCT Applicant's Guide Updates for news, fee table revisions and guidance changes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regulatory and procedural changes occur; applicants and practitioners should monitor WIPO newsletters, Applicant's Guide updates and PCT Circulars to remain current on practices and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the PCT Information Service for questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact the PCT Information Service team to answer general and legal questions and guide you through using the PCT System
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When in doubt or for case-specific procedural/legal queries, contact the PCT Infoline (phone/email) for authoritative assistance and clarification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand territorial coverage of the PCT (Contracting States)
rubrics_metrics.description: A single international patent application successfully filed under the PCT has the same legal effect as filing separate patent applications in all Contracting States; it currently has 158 Contracting States
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consider which Contracting States they may wish to pursue protection in and understand that national/regional phase entry is required to obtain enforceable rights in those States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and public access to technical disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: The PCT provides the general public with access to technical disclosures contained in international applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be aware that international applications are published and made publicly available (e.g., via PATENTSCOPE), affecting disclosure strategy and timing for confidentiality and commercialization.
